tei:div.tei:p: thugs chen gsang 'dus brgyud 'debs ni/ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs sku snying rje'i gter// zung 'jug rigs kun khyab bdag mtsho skyes rjer// gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan mthar phyin shog /'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mtsho rgyal lcam// grub gnyis 'dod rgu'i dpal brnyes lang gro rje// zab gter shing rta 'byed mdzad rat+na gling*// gsol ba 'debs so= byin rlabs char 'bebs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// phrin las thogs med mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so= byang chub sems 'byongs gang snang lha skur shar/ rtsa rlung las rung bde chen mchog dngos grub/ khregs chod thod rgal 'pho med lam mthar phyin// tshe gcig 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa'ang ma hā su kha'i bzhed ngor pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge'o// 574)
